proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ hc h1 h2 hle hge
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  let o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2) := Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation
  obtain ⟨hl, hl'⟩ := abs_sub_le_iff.mp hle
  set y := s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center with hy
  set d := dist s₁.center s₂.center with hdd
  have hdn : ‖y‖ = d := by rw [hy, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V, dist_comm]
  have hd0 : 0 < d := dist_pos.mpr hc
  set r₁ := s₁.radius
  set r₂ := s₂.radius
  set a := (d ^ 2 + r₁ ^ 2 - r₂ ^ 2) / (2 * d) with ha
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (r₁ + r₂ + d) * (r₁ + r₂ - d) * (d + r₁ - r₂) * (d - r₁ + r₂) := by
    have e1 : 0 ≤ r₁ + r₂ + d := by positivity
    have e2 : 0 ≤ r₁ + r₂ - d := by linarith
    have e3 : 0 ≤ d + r₁ - r₂ := by linarith
    have e4 : 0 ≤ d - r₁ + r₂ := by linarith
    positivity
  have hh : r₁ ^ 2 - a ^ 2 = (r₁ + r₂ + d) * (r₁ + r₂ - d) * (d + r₁ - r₂) * (d - r₁ + r₂) / (4 * d ^ 2) := by
    rw [ha]; field_simp; ring
  have hh0 : 0 ≤ r₁ ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := by rw [hh]; positivity
  set b := Real.sqrt (r₁ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) with hb
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 = r₁ ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hh0
  have hnorm : ∀ α β : ℝ, ‖α • y + β • o.rightAngleRotation y‖ ^ 2 = (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) * d ^ 2 := by
    intro α β
    rw [norm_add_sq_real, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, norm_smul, norm_smul, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, hdn, real_inner_comm, o.inner_rightAngleRotation_self]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    simp
    ring
  refine ⟨((a / d) • y + (b / d) • o.rightAngleRotation y) +ᵥ s₁.center, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mpr ((sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg h1.le).mp ?_)
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, vadd_vsub, hnorm]
    field_simp
    linarith
  · refine EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mpr ((sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg h2.le).mp ?_)
    have e : (((a / d) • y + (b / d) • o.rightAngleRotation y) +ᵥ s₁.center) -ᵥ s₂.center = (a / d - 1) • y + (b / d) • o.rightAngleRotation y := by
      rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ s₂.center s₁.center, vadd_vsub, ← hy]
      module
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, e, hnorm]
    have e2 : a * (2 * d) = d ^ 2 + r₁ ^ 2 - r₂ ^ 2 := by rw [ha]; field_simp
    field_simp
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P), s₁.center ≠ s₂.center → 0 < s₁.radius → 0 < s₂.radius → |s₁.radius - s₂.radius| ≤ dist s₁.center s₂.center → dist s₁.center s₂.center ≤ s₁.radius + s₂.radius → ∃ T : P, T ∈ s₁ ∧ T ∈ s₂
